source_version: arXiv:2310.16344v2, revised 2024-05-21; associated CCC2024 LIPIcs article27
title: Parameterized list-inapproximability of Min CSP by a direct-product reduction

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard W[1]-hardness of parameterized 2CSP and elementary set-system combinatorics
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Full original bibliography retained; author direct-product, list consistency and set-gadget proofs included.

core_obligations: Construct the bipartite direct product of a 2CSP instance.
Extract a satisfying assignment from a bounded-list assignment using structural consistency and intersection arguments.
difficulty_reason: Adapts the combinatorial direct-product framework to alphabet sizes that are part of the input, using structural properties of list-consistent assignments to extract a satisfying assignment. The full direct-product soundness proof and W[1]-hardness consequence are grouped as one principal result; Baby PCP and rectangularity corollaries are uncounted.

dedup.scope: Root checked complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both active production lines for the exclusive DOI without neighbors. Two records count the proved Baby PIH direct-product hardness and the distinct conditional Exact Cover reduction from rectangular Average Baby PIH. Supporting lemmas, direct-product counterexample, Baby PCP and list-rectangularity corollaries are not separately counted.

locator_notes: Original label thm:baby in baby.tex; full supporting contents and figure retained. The v2 author acknowledgement notes correction of the Exact Cover proof; this task uses v2, not the older source. No claim that Average Baby PIH is proved.
